 Matthew De Gabriele averages 3.56 yellow cards and 0.56 red cards per match across the 9 matches analysed: 4.11 cards per match in total.

 Across the 9 matches analysed, home teams average 2.11 yellow cards and away teams 1.44. This describes the sample; it does not, on its own, establish favouritism.
